input.question: What is the population of Middlesex Township, Pennsylvania?

documents.text: 6,669 people , 2,298 households , and 1,730 families residing in the township . The population density was 257.2 inhabitants per square mile ( 99.3/km 2 ) . There were 2,392 housing units at an average density of 92.3 units per square mile ( 35.6 units/km 2 ) .
